photos.alt: The colonial before construction, seen head-on from the street: a two-story main house beside a single-story two-car garage wing sitting under a lower roofline, with tan siding and brown shutters
The same house before construction from the driveway, showing the garage wing roof meeting the main house well below the second-floor windows
Rear of the house before construction, with the original single-story wing, brick chimney, and a raised deck off the back overlooking the yard

The new second story mid-build, framed and dried in: stud walls and roof rafters exposed, exterior sheathing and insulation board in place, double-hung windows set, and rough electrical run to open boxes over a bare subfloor

Second-floor hallway mid-build, looking down the framed corridor: exposed stud walls and roof rafters, flexible duct and wiring run overhead, recessed light housings hung, and new windows set above a bare subfloor
The house from the driveway mid-build, with the new second story sheathed over the garage, roof shingled and windows installed, and a skip and work truck in the drive
A framed second-floor bedroom with vaulted rafters overhead, three new windows set, recessed light housings hung, and the first sheets of drywall stacked against the studs
The rear elevation mid-build, with the new second story sheathed and roofed above the original single-story wing, standing alongside the brick chimney

The new bathroom mid-tile, with blue onyx-look large-format tile set on the shower walls behind yellow levelling clips, a recessed niche framed out, and taped moisture-resistant board on the surrounding walls
The upstairs hall at finishing stage, painted white with doors hung and recessed lighting on, red oak flooring going down under builder's paper, and the new stair posts standing unfinished
The second-floor landing at finishing stage, with oak flooring laid, doors hung and painted, a flush ceiling fixture on, and drop cloths still down on the far side

The new bathroom near completion, with a blue onyx-look tile shower, chrome fixtures and hand shower, an arched white oak wall cabinet, and a wide trough sink, protective film and floor tape still in place

The new second story finished from the street in spring, siding, trim and roofline matched to the original house, with a cherry tree in bloom out front and a dumpster still in the drive as the site is cleared
The completed house from the street, with the full second story built over the two-car garage, clad in matching siding with dark shutters and garage doors, and the lawn re-established
A finished bedroom in the new second story, painted soft blue with white trim, a mirrored closet, a ceiling fan, and red oak flooring
A second finished bedroom in the addition, painted soft blue with white trim and sills, three new windows on two walls, a ceiling fan, and red oak flooring
The finished bathroom, with a blue onyx-look tile shower behind a sliding glass door, a patterned tile niche, an arched white oak wall cabinet, and a pedestal sink
The finished stair landing, with a white oak handrail and newel posts, black metal balusters, and red oak flooring running through to the new bedrooms

The bath during demolition, walls stripped back to the studs with drywall debris across the floor, plumbing stacks and rough electrical boxes exposed, and a work platform standing in the middle of the room
New subfloor and cement-board underlayment down at floor level, with a stud wall framed out for the vanity and rough wiring hanging from the opened wall beside the window
The shower area during rough-in, its curbed base and surrounding walls sheathed in cement board with the drain set in a sloped mortar bed, and orange Ditra underlayment covering the adjoining floor
Large-format marble-look floor tile being set, with yellow levelling clips at every joint, cut pieces staged across the finished run, and the plumbing wall still open to the studs

The finished bath from the doorway: a toilet screened by a half-wall carrying the bidet seat controls, the light oak double vanity with marble-look counters beyond, and the freestanding tub in the window bay
The double vanity run in light oak under brass-framed mirrors and glass sconces, with the freestanding tub and its brass floor-mounted filler at the windows beyond
The double vanity head-on, two undermount sinks set in a marble-look counter with a matching backsplash, brass faucets and pulls, and a pair of brass-framed mirrors beneath glass sconces
The freestanding oval tub centred under the triple casement window, with a brass floor-mounted filler and hand shower and a recessed niche in the wall to the right
The tub bay and the walk-in shower beside it, the shower enclosed in frameless glass with marble-look wall tile and a brass rain head, and two recessed niches in the wall between them

The walk-in shower seen from the bath, frameless glass over a half-wall with a brass towel bar, large-format marble-look wall tile, a brass rain head and hand shower, and a hexagon marble mosaic floor
The shower's glass corner under the skylight, marble-look tile carried up both walls with a rain head on each, and a square drain grate set into the hexagon mosaic floor
Inside the shower, a full wall of marble-look tile with twin rain heads, two brass mixing valves, a hand shower on a holder, and a tiled bench running across the back
Open basement room with an egress window, a white storage cabinet, and the black cable-rail staircase beside a closet with a built-in shelf
Basement rec room with a white painted brick fireplace and black glass doors, an elliptical trainer, and adjustable dumbbells on a rack
Basement bathroom vanity in gray shaker cabinetry with a white integrated sink top, brushed nickel faucet, round mirror, and a wall sconce above
Basement laundry and utility room with a top-load washer and dryer, a white sink cabinet, the electrical panel on the far wall, and a rear exterior door
Laundry room with a stainless utility sink set in white cabinetry, a washer and dryer alongside, and gray double closet doors opposite
Finished basement hallway with gray louvered bifold closet doors and a rolling steel workbench with a butcher-block top along the far wall
Basement utility area with open cedar storage shelving, a rolling steel workbench, and an open door to the room with the white brick fireplace
Basement storage room with open cedar shelving and wire baskets, a white refrigerator, and the laundry room through the opening beyond
Existing hall bathroom with a white raised-panel vanity, speckled granite counter, a wide mirror, and a tiled tub surround reflected behind it
Existing tub and shower surround tiled floor to ceiling in tan stone-look tile with a mosaic border band and two corner shelves
Existing primary bathroom before renovation, with pink walls, a blue-painted corner tub deck, a glass-door shower stall, and the ceiling opened to the roof rafters
Existing primary bath looking across the blue-painted tub deck to the white double vanity, with the ceiling drywall stripped back to the joists and rafters
Existing shower stall with sliding glass doors, cream tile and a floral border, beside the jetted tub on its blue-painted deck
Pink primary bath wall with the toilet, the corner of the jetted tub, and the doorway through to the hardwood hall, ceiling opened above the wall line
Existing white raised-panel vanity with a solid-surface top and full-width mirror, the framing and wiring exposed above it
Existing primary bath with a jetted corner tub on a blue-painted deck under a double-hung window, the glass shower stall at left and open rafters overhead
Adjoining bedroom with yellow walls and light oak flooring looking through the doorway into the primary bath, the ceiling opened to the roof framing
Rebuilt shower alcove coated in red liquid waterproofing membrane over cement board, with a recessed niche and the curb masked in blue tape, sheets of marble-look tile staged against it
Bathroom at rough-in with the drywall taped and mudded around two double-hung windows, floor protection paper down, and joint compound buckets and trowels on the floor
New partition walls hung and taped with a fresh doorway opening cut through, a step ladder and buckets of joint compound on the papered floor
Shower stall framed and boarded in cement board with a recessed niche cut in, insulation exposed at the base, and the black shower pan liner turned up over the curb
Bathroom wall skim-coated over patched drywall where the old fixtures came out, with a step ladder and a roll of floor protection paper against the wall
Shower base with the black pan liner and cement board walls in place beside a double-hung window, a shop vacuum and compound buckets on the papered floor
Tile saw set up on a stand behind plastic dust sheeting taped to the ceiling, with cement board and tile stacked against the wall beside the doorway
Finished hall bath with a white vanity and quartz top, a backlit oval mirror, matte black faucet and towel rings, and a white corner storage cabinet beside the toilet
Marble-look porcelain tub surround with a recessed niche, matte black shower head and valve, and frameless sliding glass doors on a black track
Straight-on view of the finished tub and shower, tiled floor to ceiling in marble-look porcelain with a recessed niche and matte black fittings behind sliding glass
Primary bath looking across the freestanding tub to the white double vanity, with two backlit round mirrors, matte black fixtures, and the toilet in its own alcove
Marble-look walk-in shower with a lit recessed niche and matte black hardware, the freestanding tub visible through the open glass door
Finished primary bath wall in pale blue with a matte black towel shelf, the toilet alcove, and the doorway through to the bedroom
White double vanity with a chevron-panel front, matte black bar pulls and widespread faucets, quartz top, and two backlit round mirrors against pale blue walls
Walk-in closet with white wire shelving on both walls and refinished oak flooring, looking through the doorway to the freestanding tub in the primary bath
Frosted-panel sliding door standing open to the finished hall bath, showing the marble-look tub surround and sliding glass doors beyond
The open hatch seen from the patio, its diamond-plate leaf held upright on a chain, with the deck stairs and the back of the gray-sided house behind it
Looking straight down through the open hatch into the entry shaft, the stainless frame set flush in the concrete pad and the rebar grab bar of the ladder just below the lip
Looking up the rebar ladder from the bottom of the shaft to the open hatch, with blue sky and spring branches above the rim
The barrel-vaulted concrete tunnel looking toward the exit shaft, with the ladder at the far end, a strip light on the right wall and conduit run along it
The same tunnel from the opposite side, the poured concrete vault overhead and the ladder framed in the opening at the end of the run
The tunnel looking the other way toward the shelter, the arched steel door standing open at the end of the vault beside a wall-mounted strip light
The arched steel door closed at the end of the concrete tunnel, its black leaf filling the vaulted opening
Inside the shelter room, corrugated steel deck ceiling over troweled concrete walls and a tiled floor, with the arched steel door in the far right corner
The shelter room looking toward the concrete stair that climbs back into the house, steel deck ceiling above and a capped water stub in the left wall
The shelter room with the arched door open onto the lit tunnel beyond, caged bulkhead lights on either wall fed by surface conduit, and outlets set low
The shelter room with the arched steel door latched shut, a caged bulkhead light overhead, and tiled steps leading up to the doorway into the finished lower level
The passage into the shelter under an exposed steel deck ceiling, a junction box and surface conduit feeding a hanging bulb over the tiled floor
The shelter's vault door standing open, its brass five-spoke handle and pinned edge in the foreground, with the lit concrete passage beyond
The garage before work, one paneled door closed and the second bay standing open on the tan brick elevation under gray lap siding
The same elevation from the driveway before work, the closed paneled door beside the open bay, with a recycling bin at the brick corner
Inside the garage before work, two red steel shoring posts standing under the beam line, a workbench and tool chests along the left wall, and a step up through an open door into the house
The elevation mid-job, the garage opening boarded over with sheathing, a dumpster on the driveway, and ladders up to the second story where the siding has been stripped to felt and Tyvek is going on
The same elevation from across the lawn, showing how far the wrap has been carried along the upper story above the brick, with staging and ladders set against the wall

The garage interior stripped to studs and joists, a grey steel beam carried across the ceiling where the shoring posts had stood, sheathing and insulation exposed on the walls, and a new window opening cut in the far wall
A linear trench drain being set into the concrete at the door threshold, with the slab inside masked in red waterproofing membrane taped off at the edge and bags of concrete mix stacked alongside
A slatwall run going up over the finished epoxy floor, blue tape marking a stud line down the middle of the panels and the top course still open to the blocking above
The finished elevation head-on, two white garage doors with staggered glass panels set in the tan brick under a gray gambrel second story and a copper-capped bay window
The same elevation closer, the paired doors and brick pier centered under the gambrel roof, with a climbing rose on the split-rail fence to the left
The garage wing from across the lawn, the gambrel end and its side dormer in gray siding above the brick, joined back to the house beyond the red maple
The finished interior looking out through both open bays to the lawn and trees, slatwall carried around the walls above a flake epoxy floor and recessed lights across the white ceiling
The interior from the far corner, both doors up on the driveway and the neighbouring house, with the cabinet run and wood workbench along the right-hand wall
The full width of the finished garage, tall gray cabinets and a workbench along the left wall, a glazed door through to the house, and recessed lighting over the flake epoxy floor
One bay open to the fence line, the cabinet run and wood-topped workbench centered on the back wall between slatwall panels
The storage wall in detail, full-height gray cabinets with long steel pulls beside a butcher-block workbench, drawer banks below and upper cabinets over a slatwall backsplash
The garage looking back toward the closed doors, slatwall wrapping the walls to a granite-chip base and the steel post left exposed at the beam line
The rear corner of the finished garage, a white service door on its raised step between slatwall runs, with two new windows looking onto the trees

bath-office-conversion-silver-spring.intro: The full arc of the job - the office as it stood, demolition back to the frame, tile going up, and both finished bathrooms.

photos.alt: The room before conversion, used as a home office: a white sit-stand desk with two monitors and a printer set into a corner of mint-green board-and-batten panelling, under double-hung windows with white blinds and teal curtains, on a hardwood floor
The room before conversion from the opposite corner, showing the run of windows along two walls, the desk and office chair in the far corner, and a folding treadmill stored against the panelled wall

The narrow end of the room before conversion: bare mint-green board-and-batten walls meeting at an inside corner beside a single curtained window, with the hardwood floor and the edge of the treadmill in frame

The room stripped to the studs in demolition, panelling and finish flooring gone: bare framing over black building paper, the original wood-trimmed windows still set on two walls, salvaged lumber stacked at right, and new pipe roughed in along the floor at the corner

The subfloor cut open between the joists to run new supply and waste lines to a room that had none, with the wall framing and building paper exposed below the window sills and cement board laid over the rest of the floor

The shower stall at left tiled in vertical fluted porcelain with a recessed niche cut into the back wall, seen from the doorway alongside the main room in green moisture-resistant board with its cement board floor laid, a stepladder and buckets still in the space

Inside the shower stall mid-tiling: vertical fluted wood-look tile set across the back and side walls with yellow leveling clips still standing in the joints, a recessed niche in the right wall, and the shower pan protected under cardboard

The tub wall of the new bath tiled in marble-look porcelain with a recessed niche set into it, the alcove tub in and the same tile carried across the floor, the window still stripped back to bare trim, and the vanity at right with its sink basin sitting loose on top over the assembly paperwork

The bath nearing completion, with marble-look tile carried up the tub surround and across the floor, a wood vanity and toilet set in place, the sink basin still loose on the vanity top, joint compound drying over green moisture-resistant board, and a temporary work light hung from the ceiling box
The floating oak double vanity in the finished room, two brass faucets over a single white trough top, twin arched brass mirrors on a marble-look slab surround, and the corner windows to the left
The same double vanity from the doorway side, with a brass sconce between the arched mirrors, the slab backsplash running up the wall, and the fluted shower reflected in the far mirror
The second finished bathroom seen from its doorway: an alcove tub under a brass curtain rod, a window over the toilet, and a light oak vanity with a round mirror on marble-look floor tile
The tub in the second bathroom, its surround tiled floor to ceiling in veined marble-look porcelain with a recessed niche and brass fittings, beside a window with a brass grab bar below it
The vanity wall of the second bathroom, with a light oak cabinet, a brass faucet and round mirror, an open brass shelf, and the toilet beneath a window looking into the trees

The kitchen before work, looking across the granite-topped oak island toward the double wall oven and gas cooktop, with golden oak raised-panel wall cabinets running to the ceiling and a fluorescent light panel overhead

The kitchen before work from the family-room side, the stainless refrigerator boxed in by oak cabinetry at left, the range and microwave along the back wall, and the island counter running out toward the sink run at right

The sink wall before work, with a roller shade over the window, small appliances crowding the speckled granite counter, and the island in the foreground opening onto the breakfast table and its pendant light
The corner run before work: oak base and wall cabinets meeting at an inside corner, the sink and a black dishwasher under the window, and a corded wall phone mounted beside the upper cabinets

The cooking wall before work, with a stainless gas range under a white slide-out range hood set into the oak cabinetry, an over-counter microwave to its left, and the granite counter continuing to the right

The refrigerator bay before work, seen from the family room: the stainless refrigerator flanked by oak cabinets and a short granite counter used for pantry storage, with the dining room visible through the opening beyond

The kitchen before renovation seen down the length of the granite island: golden oak raised-panel cabinets on three walls, a gas range under a wood hood cabinet, a stainless refrigerator at left, and a window over the sink

The sink wall stripped of every cabinet and counter, the drywall behind them patched and taped in bands where the boxes had been, with capped supply lines and a drain stub standing at the sink location and the floor covered in protection board taped at the seams

The gutted kitchen from the family-room side, cabinets gone and the walls patched, a plastic dust barrier hung across the doorway, and a stepladder, shop vacuum, level, and bagged debris standing on the protected floor

The stripped kitchen looking toward the breakfast windows, with the old range pulled off its wall and parked at right, an open junction box left in the patched drywall, and cordless tools and lumber laid out on the covered floor

The corner by the window after demolition, taped drywall bands marking the old upper and base cabinet runs, an electrical box opened up to bare studs and cable, and capped water lines and a drain arm standing clear of the wall

Plastic sheeting sealing the kitchen off from the rest of the house, with the old yellow wall paint exposed behind a removed cabinet, an opening cut to the framing around a junction box, and stacked trim and drywall offcuts leaning against the wall

The empty room with new recessed lights set in the patched ceiling, every wall taped and floated where the cabinets came off, the gas line capped and standing at the range wall, and drop cloths and a stepladder across the covered floor

The finished kitchen from the range end, the Wolf dual range and stainless chimney hood set against a full-height marble-look slab backsplash, dove-gray shaker cabinetry with glass-front display uppers, and a dark-stained island under a white quartz top

The finished island from the refrigerator end, its dark-stained cabinetry holding a stainless microwave drawer and deep drawers under a white quartz top, with the built-in Sub-Zero and wine cubbies at left and the range wall beyond

The finished sink run under the window, a stainless apron-front farmhouse sink and pull-down faucet set in white quartz against the marble-look slab, with the island and the breakfast area and its nickel chandeliers beyond

The finished corner by the sink, dove-gray shaker cabinets carried to the ceiling with glass-front uppers, brushed nickel bar pulls, a marble-look slab backsplash, and a tall pantry cabinet with a lift-up door at right

The rebuilt refrigerator bay, the built-in Sub-Zero flanked by full-height gray cabinetry with a wine rack and glass door above, seen from the family room with the dining room through the opening at right

The cooking wall finished, the Wolf dual range with red knobs under a stainless chimney hood, the marble-look slab backsplash carried to the underside of the wall cabinets, and white quartz counters running the length of the run
Mid-century split-level brick home before construction, with a low single-story attached garage wing under a shingled roof and a bare autumn treeline behind it

The upper level framed and sheathed in OSB, with exposed ceiling joists carrying wiring and recessed light housings, blue electrical boxes on the studs, a knee wall under the right-hand window opening covered in poly sheeting, and PVC pipe stock and a supply box on the new subfloor

Wider view across the framed addition, stud partitions dividing the rooms with ceiling joists and looped cable runs overhead, a window opening sealed in poly sheeting, coils of wire and offcuts on the subfloor, and a step ladder in the far room

The framed bathroom with plumbing roughed in - a PVC drain stack and shower valve set into the stud wall, a toilet flange in the subfloor, blue electrical boxes on the studs at right, and a green step ladder leaning against the OSB wall under a poly-covered window opening

The same room after insulation, with kraft-faced batts between the studs, a white insulation blanket across the ceiling, and the new picture window installed with the manufacturer's sticker still on the glass

Wider view of the insulated addition, kraft-faced batts filling the stud bays and the ceiling blanketed, with the new windows installed and one of them looking across to the brick of the original house
The room drywalled and painted white with the picture window trimmed out, white oak plank flooring being laid across the space, and a joint compound bucket and stacked offcuts against the wall

A bedroom with the drywall painted and a closet framed out with shelf and rod, its oak plank flooring partly laid, bundles of boards and green underlayment stacked across the rest of the floor behind blue tape lines, and a hung door standing open to the hall
The bathroom with painted drywall and the shower alcove lined in cement board ready for tile, trim stock leaning in the opening, a bucket of compound on the bare floor, and a new slider window above

The addition from the back yard - a new second story built over the garage wing, clad in tan panel under an angled roofline with full-height glazing, standing alongside the original brick two-story with its teal accent panels, with saw horses, a tarp, lumber and a mitre saw still set up in the foreground

The upstairs hallway drywalled and painted, the stairwell opening at left behind a temporary ledger, the floor covered in protective paper taped down in blue, a clerestory window high on the left wall, and the bathroom through the door at right still lined in cement board

The hallway looking the other way, a run of clerestory windows above the stair opening at right, hung doors along the left wall, and oak flooring under taped protective paper running back to a further room
A finished bedroom in the addition, white walls and trim over wide white oak plank flooring, with a long picture window framing the treeline and recessed lights and a supply register in the ceiling

A finished bedroom with a wide sliding closet door on the left wall and a panelled door standing open to the landing, where the cable-rail stair is visible, with a square window looking across to the brick of the original house

The finished bathroom - a floating fluted oak vanity with a vessel sink and matte black tap, a wall of ribbed wood-look tile carrying a black rain head and hand shower, and large-format stone-look floor tile running into the curbless shower

The upstairs landing finished, with a white oak handrail and black cable balustrade around the stair opening, oak flooring throughout, a clerestory window along the left wall, and the wood-tiled bathroom through the doorway at right
The landing looking along the cable-rail balustrade, oak treads dropping away below, a run of clerestory windows above the rail, and panelled doors along the left wall

The bathroom from the doorway, a frameless glass panel dividing the curbless wood-tiled shower from the vanity, with floating oak shelves, a black-framed mirror and brass sconces against the white and gold patterned tile

The bathroom vanity wall - a floating fluted oak cabinet with a vessel sink under a black-framed mirror flanked by brass sconces, set against a white and gold geometric feature tile, with the glass shower beyond

The bathroom seen from the landing through its doorway, the oak vanity and patterned tile at right, with the cable-rail balustrade and a clerestory window looking onto the original brick roofline at left
Detail of the shower - a square matte black rain head and hand shower on the ribbed wood-look tile wall, with the corner window above and the vanity and open shelving reflected through the glass

The vanity straight on, its fluted oak drawers and white counter under a black-framed mirror between brass sconces, with floating shelves beside the toilet and the wood-tiled shower behind glass at right

The finished elevation - the new second story over the garage wing in tan panel with an angled mid-century roofline, full-height glazing and teal accent panels picked up from the original entry band, beside the original brick two-story

The island from the refrigerator side, its navy base and white quartz top running the length of the room past five tan leather stools, with the built-in refrigerator at left and the wall ovens and brass faucet beyond

Looking down the length of the navy island toward the breakfast bay, the stainless cooktop set into the run with brass knobs and bail pulls, the panelled wall ovens and refrigerator at right, and the stair to the upper floor beyond

The coffee bar in the breakfast room, navy base cabinets under a white quartz counter holding a kettle and coffee maker, with the bow window over the yard and floor-to-ceiling white pantry cabinets on the right-hand wall

The kitchen looking from the refrigerator toward the apron-front sink under the window, white cabinetry and stacked wall ovens along the left wall, the navy island with its stainless cooktop and brass faucet on the right, and new white oak flooring running the length between them
The island's six-burner cooktop and undermount prep sink under three brass pendants, with the white perimeter cabinets and apron-front sink at left and the dining table and open stair beyond

The sink run under the window: a white apron-front sink with a black spring-neck faucet and brass bridge handles, then dishwasher drawers, an undercounter refrigerator, a glass-front wine cooler, and a stainless tap tower set along the white quartz counter

The long run of white shaker cabinetry with aged-brass bin pulls and bail handles, the stacked double wall oven built in at left beside the stainless refrigerator, and a dishwasher panelled into the base run under the marble-look slab backsplash

The island's downdraft vent raised behind the six-burner cooktop, with the brass faucet and undermount prep sink to the right, the apron-front sink and white perimeter run at left, and the family-room stair beyond
The breakfast room after work, a glass globe pendant hanging in front of the bow window and a wall of floor-to-ceiling white pantry cabinets with aged-brass handles, on new white oak flooring

The family room with its brick fireplace wall painted charcoal, a reclaimed timber mantel on black iron brackets above the brass-framed firebox, and four windows carrying black iron drapery rods along the far wall

The family room seen straight on to the charcoal brick chimney breast, the timber mantel and raised brick hearth centred between painted walls, with the windows and their black drapery hardware at right and new white oak floors throughout
The family room looking back toward the kitchen, the half-wall stair rail opening onto the island and its stools, a step up to the kitchen floor, and two panelled doors on the right-hand wall

The primary bedroom seen straight on to the bed under a vaulted ceiling, a black three-blade fan and recessed lights overhead, a wall-mounted television at left, and new red oak flooring running to the open door onto the stair landing

The bedroom from the far corner, two curtained windows over the yard, a light oak dresser and mirror against the wall, an upholstered armchair and floor lamp at left, and the door through to the upstairs hall

The bedroom from the dresser side, the vaulted ceiling carrying back over the bed, the television on the chimney wall, and the panelled door standing open onto the landing and its black metal balusters

The bedroom looking through the double stained-wood doors into the primary bath, the glass shower enclosure and the end of the freestanding tub visible beyond, with an armchair and curtained window to the right

The primary bath looking across the quartz vanity top to the freestanding tub set under the window between two ribbed glass sconces, with the glass shower enclosure at right and stone-look porcelain tile underfoot
The stained oak double vanity under two arched mirrors and chrome sconces, quartz counters with undermount basins and brushed nickel widespread faucets, and the doorway back into the bedroom at left

The vanity run seen along its length, square brass knobs and pulls on the stained oak drawers under a marble-look quartz top, with the walk-in shower and its marble slab surround at the left of the frame

Inside the walk-in shower, two full shower sets with hand showers on the marble-look slab wall either side of a long recessed niche, a floating marble bench along the left return, towels on hooks at right, and a mosaic tile floor

A closer view of the shower wall, the recessed niche running between the two brushed brass valve sets and hand showers, the tile changing from vertical gloss above the marble band to large-format slab below, over the mosaic floor

The shower looking in from the tub, two brass rain heads on the ceiling drop, the floating marble bench along the back wall, a linear drain at the threshold, and the bath window and freestanding tub reflected in the glass

The suite's bath before work, looking across the tiled tub deck to a glass shower enclosure over a pink tub, twin pedestal sinks under dark-stained mirror cabinets, and a pink toilet, with the opening through to the bedroom at right

The vanity wall before work, twin white pedestal sinks against square white wall tile under a run of dark-stained mirror cabinets and fluorescent light bars, a pink toilet beside them, and a stained plywood wall cabinet on the right-hand wall

The bedroom early in the work, floor protection paper taped down over the existing plank floor, a section of wall opened at the base to expose supply lines and a shut-off, and the corner window looking onto the courtyard

The bath taken back to the studs, a new shower compartment framed at left with its mixing valve set between PEX supply lines, the opposite wall opened to show copper stacks, insulated ducting and new electrical boxes, and cement board laid over the floor

The framed shower from the doorway, the waterproof pan liner folded up the curb and walls, the valve roughed in on the back wall, and the opposite stud bay carrying copper, PVC waste lines and outlet boxes ready for inspection

The bedroom with drywall hung and taped, spare sheets and a mirror leaning against the far wall, tools and buckets staged on the papered floor, and the doorway at left still open to the framed bath beyond
The bedroom boarded out and primed, new switch and outlet boxes set into the finished walls, the window trimmed, and tools, pipe fittings and buckets staged on the protected floor
The bedroom's window corner with drywall finished and the walls primed, a ceiling box hanging ready for a light, and buckets, a shop vacuum and materials gathered in the middle of the papered floor

The finished bath from the vanity end, the freestanding tub under the window with its brushed brass floor filler, and the glass shower beyond carrying chevron-laid marble across both walls over a hex mosaic floor
The shower's chevron marble wall with corner shelves and a brass shower set behind frameless glass, facing the floating teak vanity with its white trough basins, backlit mirror and stacked towels

The double trough basin along the floating vanity, brushed brass faucets against a backlit mirror, towels rolled on the teak shelf below, and the freestanding tub and its floor filler beyond the doorway
The finished suite looking from the shower across the vanity and through the open door to the bedroom, with the chevron marble, hex mosaic floor and backlit mirror on one side and the bed beyond

The bedroom looking through the open door into the finished bath, the chevron marble shower and mosaic floor visible beyond, with a walnut dresser, diamond mirrors, and the fireplace room through the opening at right
The finished bedroom from the closet wall, the leather bed centred between walnut nightstands and globe lamps, tall windows on two sides, and new plank flooring under a deep pile rug
The finished bedroom from the opposite corner, the bed framed by windows on three sides looking into the trees, a walnut dresser at left, and the shag rug over new plank flooring
